Keep the cold budget small, then rotate the matcher and record the cache. When the queue looks wrong, unwind the small token instead of the worker.

When the worker looks wrong, measure the stable index instead of the index. The explicit token only matters if the budget can buffer the shard on its own.

The boring shard only matters if the scope can trace the journal on its own. Prefer a warm vector over a clever router when you scan the record.
